source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes one CEML URI, checks three values and drops the source-required IPMI comparison, left-module mapping, trusted transport and redaction.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED restores exact member/channel mapping, complete field parity and no-write controls.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 952/2291 accepts the partial direct GET without distinguishing the left CEM module from CEMBB or CEMR.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Adjacent CEMBB and CEMR records are separate physical FRUs and are negative controls against a left/right/baseboard swap.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 retains all original interfaces; ED-34 permits bounded tooling; ED-35 rejects three-field coverage; ED-36 treats board maps and reference data as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify the left CEM module FRU is correctly identified and that all required FRU_CEML values agree across BMC WebUI, Redfish, the mapped read-only IPMI FRU and Project reference.
original_method: Bind the physical left CEM module to exact Redfish and IPMI identities, collect complete read-only raw data and the WebUI page, normalize vendor encodings and compare all approved fields while preserving logs and FRU state.
manual_activity: The owner identifies the left CEM slot and its management endpoints, field authority and expected content. Collection/comparison is automatable; physical/UI mapping exceptions and the verdict remain engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or host logs.
Never edit FRU storage, reset BMC or reboot for this read-only inventory case.
Prove left-slot mapping; do not accept a similarly named baseboard or right-module record.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials; redact asset identifiers.
Preserve raw values while normalizing encoding/padding.
Stop on cross-side ambiguity or unresolved source authority without automatic probing/retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate one left CEM identity across physical map, Redfish, IPMI and WebUI.
Collect complete redacted API and timestamped read-only IPMI outputs.
Normalize the approved field set and compare it with WebUI/reference.
Report missing, stale, encoding and true mismatch results distinctly.
engineer_actions: Approve field reference, normalization, redaction and source authority.
Resolve exceptions and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET is only a candidate partial read: it assumes identity, bypasses TLS, omits IPMI and cannot prevent left/right/baseboard substitution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover FRU_CEML, bind the exact left-slot IPMI FRU and compare complete protected raw-to-normalized data plus WebUI.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_CEML, WebUI and ipmitool parity, readable/correct Criterion and 2/0-minute estimates are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use slot-bound Redfish/IPMI/WebUI parity with complete encoding-aware FRU evidence.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CEML FRU map/layout and Project manufacturing record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds left-slot identity, secure access, complete fields and redaction without replacing the original comparisons.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three API fields do not cover IPMI, WebUI or the complete FRU record.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Left-slot map, endpoints, layout/reference and authority rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Left and right modules may share product data, so serial/location binding is essential.

project_override_considerations: Alternate FRU tooling is acceptable only with recorded approval, exact left-module binding, per-field equivalence and uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: Physical left CEM and BMC identity with exact Redfish/IPMI mapping
Complete redacted Redfish and read-only IPMI raw outputs
WebUI/reference evidence and encoding-aware per-field matrix
Explicit proof CEMBB/CEMR were not selected
Preserved logs, no-write evidence and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: FRU_CEML and the WebUI/IPMI comparison are internally consistent. Incompleteness exists only in the DeepSeek proposal.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Left-module FRU parity is understandable; platform mappings and expected fields are normal readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores full IPMI/UI parity and prevents assumed-member substitution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees on hybrid readiness and complete protected evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds the missing left-slot identity boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Uses CEMBB/CEMR as distinct identities, not interchangeable evidence.

review_improvement: Makes left/right/baseboard separation an explicit acceptance condition and preserves raw evidence for every normalized FRU field.
independent_technical_reasoning: CEML and CEMR may report identical manufacturer/product values, so those three fields cannot identify a side. Slot linkage and unique serial/device mapping must precede comparison, otherwise correct data from the right module can falsely satisfy the left-module case.
